title: Outcomes of the Fifth Plenum, with Katja Drinhausen and Daria Impiombato
gist: MERICS podcast episode (blurb only, ~155 words) in which Katja Drinhausen and Daria Impiombato discuss outcomes of the CCP Central Committee's fifth plenary session, key personnel changes, and the road to the 21st Party Congress next year. The text contains only the episode description, no substantive analysis.

themes.theme: CCP fifth plenum and succession runway

insights.claim: The Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party held its fifth plenary session in late October 2026, with MERICS framing its significance around key personnel changes.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: Personnel reshuffles at plenums are leading signals for policy direction and elite stability in China.

insights.claim: MERICS positions the fifth plenum as a waypoint on the road to the CCP's 21st Party Congress in 2027, making next year's congress the key political event to watch for China's leadership line-up.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: The 21st Party Congress is the next major catalyst for China leadership/policy risk repricing.
insights.quote: the road ahead to next year’s 21st party congress
